verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships a first-party Python API with transformers-style `AutoModel` / `AutoConfig` / `AutoEngine` and `AutoEngine.from_pretrained(...)`, so developers can build against it in Python. Its OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` server also lets existing OpenAI client libraries work, though those are not Edge0's own SDKs. The iOS, Android, Windows and macOS components are described as apps and native engines, not as client SDKs. Missing for 10: official SDKs beyond Python (e.g. JS/TS, Swift, Kotlin client libraries), SDK reference documentation, versioned and published packages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
